description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a tic-tac-toe game board with interactive cells, including animations and styling.

classes.name: GameBoard
classes.description: Stateless widget representing a 3x3 tic-tac-toe grid with tap animations and styling.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: A private widget representing an individual cell in the game board, handling animations and tap interactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the GameBoard, creating a grid of interactive cells.

methods.name: _handleTapDown
methods.description: Handles the tap down gesture, triggering visual feedback.

methods.name: _handleTapCancel
methods.description: Handles the tap cancel gesture, resetting the visual feedback.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles the tap action on a cell, invoking the callback.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the _BoardCell widget.
